title: Smashed
textBlocks:
Rule 1 & 2
Moses comes down the mountain
only to find a big problem

The people got tired of waiting for Moses - so they made Aaron MAKE them a golden calf. Aaron melted their gold earrings and MADE them an IDOL.
and then they started to worship it!
THEY BROKE THE FIRST 2 RULES
that God had just given them!
Moses was so angry that he smashed the 2 stone tablets down and they broke into pieces!

Then Moses went back to God to beg for his forgiveness for what the people had done
God was also angry - he sent a plague because they had made an IDOL
Remember the 1st rule is to only have 1 God
& the 2nd rule is do not to make or worship idols

PRAYER TIME
Dear Lord Jesus
Please help me to let my light shine
Please help me to follow your rules
and thank you for loving me
Amen
